Tynwald ( Manx : Tinvaal ), or more formally, the High Court of Tynwald ( Ard-whaiyl Tinvaal ) or Tynwald Court , is the legislature of the Isle of Man . Established in 979 according to tradition or in the 13th century according to available historical evidence, it is the oldest continuous legislature in the world, [ 1 ] [ 2 ] and the second oldest legislature in the world, after the Althing , which was established in 930, disbanded in 1800, and restored in 1845.
